description: Assess labor market health for housing demand. Returns employment, construction jobs, residential building employment, unemployment rate, and job openings. All BLS monthly releases; each series carries its own `observation_date` and `cadence` (JOLTS runs an extra month behind CES/LAUS), and `freshness` states the span. `snapshot_date` is the call date, not the data date.

_blsKey.description: BLS registration key (optional — raises the shared quota; https://data.bls.gov/registrationEngine/)

_fredKey.description: FRED API key (accepted for consistency but not used — BLS is free)

name: housing_employment_outlook
